title: Quantum Primitive for Output-Hiding Function Sharing: QKD and Joint Computation Applications
summary: Applications of the proposed primitive: Quantum Primitive for Output-Hiding Function Sharing, are discussed for secure quantum communications and computation protocols. In particular, QKD applications provide notable enhanced security and efficiency properties relative to status-quo protocols. Additionally, we provide examples when parties may wish to encode joint functions, or decisions, which remain information-theoretically hidden from external parties and those internal to the quantum system, without additional private keys, hidden randomness, or classical communication.
